title: Rongorongo and Nazca lines as depictions of plasma discharges

tellings.quote: that when they were in uh Easter Island um his wife Katie they were looking at this what was thought to be a writing called rango rango

plain: Rongorongo, marks on Easter Island long thought to be a form of writing, and the Nazca lines, giant drawings on the ground in Peru, are said to be pictures of plasma discharges, glowing electrical bursts in the sky. The researcher Matt LaCroix relays it from the researcher Robert Schoch, author of the book Forgotten Civilizations, and his wife Katie, who looked at the rongorongo marks on Easter Island. If true, it would mean ancient people were recording a sky event, not words.
